summary: Pine Mountain lookout in Deerfield Township, Cass County, MN, about four miles west of Backus. FFLA lists it gone; no build, staffing or removal details found.

facts.status_note: Only the Fire Lookout Association's Minnesota list says gone, and it gives no date. A 2010 USGS map description names the tower, which does not show that a structure stood.

events.note: A 2010 USGS print map of Backus, as described by Pastmaps, names the Pine Mountain Lookout Tower. The description does not say whether a structure stood at the spot.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only status source is the FFLA list (Pine Mountain, Cass, 46.82415, -94.60343, Tower Gone), which gives no date; its coordinates match the record. Mapcarta's page is an automated view of GeoNames and Wikidata data, not a history. It places the tower in Deerfield Township, about four miles west of Backus, at 46.82413, -94.60334. The Pastmaps description of a 2010 USGS map names the tower, which shows the name on a map and not that a structure stood. Searches returned other Pine Mountain towers (Arkansas, Mississippi, Cook County MN); none were used. The Forest Lookouts Minnesota list has no Pine Mountain entry. No build date, builder, staffing, fire, removal or present-day source was found in what we read, so those are left out. The Mapcarta elevation is ground elevation, not tower height, so height_m is omitted. Suggested check: Cass County or Backus local history, a DNR or Forest Service record, or a dated site visit with landowner permission.
